description:
Upgrade ONE Odoo Community database to the next major with OpenUpgrade (validated live 17→18).
    PREREQUISITE: the target-version Odoo must already be installed on the box (acquire_source +
    install for odoo_major=target) - run `upgrade_assess` first for the plan. This tool then, on the
    box: backs up the DB (pg_dump, your rollback), fetches OpenUpgrade for the target, installs
    openupgradelib, stops Odoo, runs `odoo --update all` with the OpenUpgrade migration scripts, and
    validates the DB reached the target before restarting. dry_run (default) shows the exact steps;
    confirm=true (after a matching dry_run) executes. ONE major per call - for 17→19 run it twice.
    COMMUNITY only; Enterprise uses Odoo's official upgrade platform (separate). Destructive-ish: it
    mutates a real DB, but always backs up first and aborts (restoring service) on any failure.
    19->20 is refused (no_openupgrade_branch) until OCA publishes OpenUpgrade 20.0; for 20 use the
    new-database path (workflow: odoo20_move_order).
name: upgrade_run
